scope: Explicit actual current catalogue fixture authoring for five service suites, valid observation boundaries and corrected168-file whole-core discovery. No production write/read/authorization behavior changes.

firstRed.reason: Legacy Step[] package seeds author no actual catalogue steps; actual/progress/measure services refuse those absent points.

interim.reason: Remaining measure assertions retain insertion order instead of documented metric order. Exact literal arrays now follow actual metric order; neither production sorting nor identity checks change.

statusInterim.reason: One earlier stale_undo revision refusal differs from old parent-hold detail. Observer insert misses atomic writeFirstChild; assigning a wrapper to a Source proxy target reenters its coordinator for move, timing out two cases. Plain per-service facades now decorate actual writers without changing Source proxy targets.
